concept: EC2 purchasing: Spot for interruptible, fault-tolerant batch jobs
tests: Cheapest compute option for a nightly ETL that can be rerun if interrupted.
expected: Spot Instances: maximum discount for interruptible, restartable batch jobs. Triggers: "nightly", "about two hours", "tolerate occasional reruns", "minimize compute cost".
why_not: On-Demand costs more; Reserved Instances are for steady 24/7 load, not 2 hours a day; Dedicated Hosts are the most expensive, for licensing/compliance.
